about.description: Catalog of camera manufacturers, product lines, models, USB identities and line quirks used to build documented (not hardware-verified) camera profiles.
about.sources: Facts and citations only. Model tables, USB IDs, flags and opcodes come from the libgphoto2 camlibs/ptp2 sources pinned at commit 02d92fea8a269eb94330a4eade204ba799433606 (cited per entry by permalink); no libgphoto2 code is included. quirks.description: EOS-protocol bodies do nothing remote until the host enables remote mode (0x9114 SetRemoteMode, param 1) and event mode (0x9115 SetEventMode, param 1). libgphoto2 then optionally sends 0x913D SetRequestOLCInfoGroup(0x1FFF), drains events, calls 0x9108 GetDeviceInfoEx, re-fetches the standard DeviceInfo, and drains events again. Teardown sends SetRemoteMode(0)/(1) and SetEventMode(0).
quirks.simulatorBehaviour: Gate all vendor ops except GetDeviceInfo/OpenSession/0x9114/0x9115 until SetRemoteMode(!=0) and SetEventMode(1) have been received; return DeviceBusy or GeneralError before. After remote mode is enabled, the standard GetDeviceInfo should advertise additional ops/props (DeviceInfo changes after mode switch).

quirks.description: Canon EOS does not use the USB interrupt endpoint for property changes or new objects. The host polls 0x9116 GetEvent (no params, data-in). The data phase is a concatenation of records [u32 size][u32 type][payload], terminated by an 8-byte record whose type is 0. Record types reuse event codes: 0xC189 PropValueChanged, 0xC18A AvailListChanged (enum list for a property), 0xC181 ObjectAddedEx, 0xC186 RequestObjectTransfer, 0xC18B CameraStatusChanged, 0xC18E ShutdownTimerUpdated, 0xC194 BulbExposureTime, 0xC1A5 OLCInfoChanged, 0xC1A7 ObjectAddedEx64, 0xC1A9 RequestObjectTransfer64.
quirks.simulatorBehaviour: Keep a per-session change queue; return everything that changed since the last 0x9116 in one blob. The first GetEvent after enabling event mode must dump the full current state of all properties (PropValueChanged) plus every AvailListChanged list. Occasionally return an empty blob on the very first call (libgphoto2 retries up to 10x until EVFOutputDevice 0xD1B0 appears).

quirks.description: Properties are written with 0x9110 SetDevicePropValueEx (data-out: [u32 size][u32 propcode][value]) rather than the standard 0x1016. Values are reported back only through the next GetEvent PropValueChanged record, not via a DevicePropChanged interrupt event. 0x9127 RequestDevicePropValue asks the body to push a property into the event queue; it returns GeneralError for props that do not exist on that body (libgphoto2 logs and ignores).
quirks.simulatorBehaviour: Implement 0x9110 to update the property store and enqueue a PropValueChanged record; reject 0x1016 for EOS-only props (0xD1xx). Implement 0x9127 to enqueue one PropValueChanged record or return 0x2002 GeneralError if unknown.

quirks.description: Shutter is driven by 0x9128 RemoteReleaseOn(stage, 0) / 0x9129 RemoteReleaseOff(stage): stage 1 = half-press (AF), stage 2 = full press. libgphoto2 does half-press, polls GetEvent until focus info arrives (OLCInfoChanged / FocusInfoEx), then full-press, full-release, half-release. EOS M bodies instead use RemoteReleaseOn(3,0) as a combined press. Older bodies only support 0x910F RemoteRelease.
quirks.simulatorBehaviour: Model a button state machine: Off->Half (start AF, after delay emit OLCInfo/FocusInfoEx change)->Full (expose, then queue ObjectAddedEx/RequestObjectTransfer). Return a Canon error if Full is requested without Half on regular EOS; accept stage 3 on EOS M profiles.

quirks.description: Where captures go is selected by EOS prop 0xD11C CaptureDestination (card vs host RAM); when saving to host, libgphoto2 also announces free PC disk space with 0x911A PCHDDCapacity and checks 0xD11B AvailableShots. Images destined for the host arrive as RequestObjectTransfer(64) records and the host must download then call 0x9117 TransferComplete.
quirks.simulatorBehaviour: When CaptureDestination=host, do not write to card storage; create a transient object, emit RequestObjectTransfer in GetEvent, serve it via 0x9104/0x9171 GetObject, then delete on 0x9117. If PCHDDCapacity was never sent, report AvailableShots=0 and refuse capture.

quirks.description: Live view is enabled by setting EOS prop 0xD1B0 EVFOutputDevice (bitmask: bit0 TFT, bit1 PC) via 0x9110, then polling 0x9153 GetViewFinderData. Until frames are ready the camera answers 0xA102 (Canon ObjectNotReady) or DeviceBusy. Data is a sequence of typed blobs (JPEG plus metadata).
quirks.simulatorBehaviour: After EVFOutputDevice gets bit1, return 0xA102 for ~200-500 ms, then serve frames. Drop to 0xA102 again when EVFOutputDevice is cleared.

quirks.description: Bodies auto power-off during long remote sessions; libgphoto2 periodically sends 0x911D KeepDeviceOn (no args). ShutdownTimerUpdated (0xC18E) records appear in GetEvent.
quirks.simulatorBehaviour: Run an auto-power-off timer reset by any transaction or 0x911D; on expiry, disconnect the USB device.

quirks.description: Newer Canons report VendorExtensionID 0x00000006 (Microsoft/MTP) or 0xFFFFFFFF in DeviceInfo; hosts must key the Canon vendor set on USB VID 0x04A9 (libgphoto2 rewrites the ID to 0x0000000B).
quirks.simulatorBehaviour: Make the profile's DeviceInfo.VendorExtensionID configurable (0x0B vs 0x06) so hosts that only trust the extension ID are exercised.

quirks.description: Newer EOS firmware exposes 64-bit object ops (0x9170 GetObjectInfo64, 0x9171 GetObject64, 0x9172 GetPartialObject64, 0x9173 GetObjectInfoEx64, 0x9174 GetPartialObjectEX64) and 64-bit object events (0xC1A7 ObjectAddedEx64, 0xC1A9 RequestObjectTransfer64). Which bodies switch to the 64-bit records is not documented in the sources read.
quirks.simulatorBehaviour: Profile flag use64BitObjects: when true, emit 0xC1A7/0xC1A9 records and advertise 0x9170-0x9175.

quirks.description: 0xA102 means Canon EOS ObjectNotReady but Sony PasswordLengthOverMax in the same header: vendor response codes overlap and must be interpreted per vendor.
quirks.simulatorBehaviour: Response-code tables must be per-vendor in the simulator.

quirks.description: Sony bodies enumerate with a different USB PID depending on the camera's USB connection mode: MTP/mass-storage vs "PC Remote"/"PC Control". Only the PC-Control PID exposes the SDIO control ops. Examples: A7 IV MTP 0x0DA6 vs PC Control 0x0DA7; A7S III 0x0D17 vs 0x0D18; A6600 0x0D0F vs 0x0D10; A7 V MTP 0x0F50 vs PC Control 0x0F56; ZV-1 0x0C1B vs 0x0C44.
quirks.simulatorBehaviour: Profile has two USB personalities; switching the simulated "USB Connection" menu re-enumerates the device with the other PID and a different DeviceInfo (MTP: no 0x92xx ops).

quirks.description: Required handshake: 0x9201 SDIO_Connect phase 1, phase 2 (params 0,0), then 0x9202 SDIO_GetExtDeviceInfo(protocol 0x00C8 = "3.00" in libgphoto2; darkgrade sends initiatorVersion 3.00) repeated until it returns a non-empty code list (libgphoto2 retries up to 20x), then SDIO_Connect phase 3. The returned list mixes opcodes (0x1xxx/0x9xxx class by mask 0x7000==0x1000), events (0x4000) and props (0x5000) that must be merged into DeviceInfo. Newer Sony (SDK) also uses 0x9210 SDIO_OpenSession with a function mode (remote / content transfer).
quirks.simulatorBehaviour: Reject all 0x92xx ops except 0x9201/0x9202 until phase 3; return an empty code list for the first 1-3 GetExtDeviceInfo calls; then expose the full list.

quirks.description: Property state is read as one blob: 0x9209 SDIO_GetAllExtDevicePropInfo returns every property descriptor (libgphoto2 notes ~4 KB); the host re-reads it after 0xC203 DevicePropChanged instead of per-prop GetDevicePropDesc. darkgrade exposes a "only differences" flag on 0x9209.
quirks.simulatorBehaviour: Implement 0x9209 returning [u64 count][PropDesc*]; honour the only-differences parameter; emit 0xC203 on any change.

quirks.description: Two write paths: 0x9205 SDIO_SetExtDevicePropValue for settings ("value A") and 0x9207 SDIO_ControlDevice for button-like controls ("value B") such as 0xD2C1 ShutterHalfRelease (S1) and 0xD2C2 ShutterRelease (S2) with value 2=press, 1=release. After connect libgphoto2 sets 0xD25A PriorityMode=1 (application/PC priority) so exposure props are writable from the host.
quirks.simulatorBehaviour: Route button props only via 0x9207; reject them via 0x9205. Enforce PriorityMode: with camera priority, exposure props are read-only (GetSet=0) and writes fail.

quirks.description: Captured images to host are exposed as transient object handle 0xFFFFC001 when DPC 0xD215 ObjectInMemory >= 0x8000 (0x8001 = one image waiting). DeleteObject is not supported; the host must download it to clear it. Focus achieved is signalled by 0xD213 FocusFound changing (1->2) and 0xC203 events.
quirks.simulatorBehaviour: After S2 press, set 0xD215 to 0x8001 and emit 0xC203(0xD215) + 0xC201 ObjectAdded(0xFFFFC001); clear to 0 after GetObject. Half-press sets FocusFound=2 after AF delay unless FocusMode is manual (value 1).

quirks.simulatorBehaviour: Profile field captureReadyDelayMs (3000 for listed bodies): S1/S2 before that are silently ignored (no image).

quirks.description: Two write paths: 0x9205 SDIO_SetExtDevicePropValue for settings ("value A") and 0x9207 SDIO_ControlDevice for button-like controls ("value B") such as 0xD2C1 ShutterHalfRelease (S1) and 0xD2C2 ShutterRelease (S2) with value 2=press, 1=release. quirks.description: Captured images to host are exposed as transient object handle 0xFFFFC001 when DPC 0xD215 ObjectInMemory >= 0x8000 (0x8001 = one image waiting). sdks.name: FUJIFILM Tether Shooting Plug-in PRO (Lightroom) / X Acquire

quirks.description: Tethering requires the camera connection mode set to a tether mode (label varies by model/firmware: "PC SHOOT AUTO", "USB AUTO", "USB TETHER SHOOTING AUTO", or FIXED). In AUTO the camera behaves normally until a host connects; unplugging with pending transfers reverts to normal and loses queued images. "USB RAW CONV./BACKUP RESTORE" is a separate mode (X-E3 entry in libgphoto2 is that mode, fw 1.20+).
quirks.simulatorBehaviour: Profile usbMode: "mtp" | "tether-auto" | "tether-fixed" | "raw-conv" | "webcam"; only tether modes expose capture; in AUTO, drop queued objects on disconnect.

quirks.description: Fuji DeviceInfo under-reports properties; newer bodies return the real list via 0x902B Fuji GetDeviceInfo, older ones need a hard-coded list (0xD38C PC mode, 0xD171 focus control, 0xD207 PriorityMode, 0xD208 capture control, 0xD209 AFStatus, 0xD212 CurrentState...).
quirks.simulatorBehaviour: Omit vendor props from DeviceInfo; implement 0x902B returning the full prop list (newer profiles only).

quirks.description: Capture is driven through a control property, not a vendor op: set 0xD207 PriorityMode=2 (PC priority), write 0xD208 = 0x0200 (S1/AF), InitiateCapture(0,0), poll 0xD209 AFStatus until != 1 (2 = OK, 3 = AF failed -> write 0x0004 CancelS1 + InitiateCapture), then 0xD208 = 0x0304 (S2 shoot) + InitiateCapture. Bulb uses 0x0500 start / 0x000C end. Available 0xD208 enum values differ per body (X-Pro2 list shorter than X-T4/GFX100).
quirks.simulatorBehaviour: Implement 0xD208 as an enum whose value arms the next 0x100E InitiateCapture; model AFStatus transitions; per-profile enum list.

quirks.description: Fuji events are delivered by polling GetDevicePropValue(0xD212 CurrentState), which returns a list of (u16 code, u32 value) changes; interrupt events are unreliable (X-Pro2/X-T2 send just one ObjectAdded for the first capture, then none).
quirks.simulatorBehaviour: Implement 0xD212 as a read-and-clear change list; emit at most one interrupt ObjectAdded per session on affected profiles.

quirks.description: ExposureTime values >= 10079368 encode long exposures with special codes (e.g. 64000180 for 60 min); hosts wait up to ~2x exposure for a dark frame.
quirks.simulatorBehaviour: Use Fuji exposure code table; keep busy for 2x exposure when long-exposure NR is on.

quirks.description: Fujifilm reuses USB PIDs across models (GFX 100S and X-S10 both 0x02EA; GFX 50S II matches GFX100 entry). Model must come from DeviceInfo.
quirks.simulatorBehaviour: Allow PID collisions across profiles.

quirks.description: Fuji Wi-Fi uses PTP/IP-like init on TCP 55740 but then a USB-bulk-like framing ([u32 len][u16 type][u16 code][u32 transid][params]); events on 55741 and live-view JPEG stream on 55742 open only after InitiateOpenCapture. DeviceInfo over Wi-Fi is partly synthesised by libgphoto2.
quirks.simulatorBehaviour: Fuji network personality listens on 55740/55741/55742 with Fuji framing, not standard PTP/IP on 15740.

quirks.description: Older Fuji (S5 Pro) report Microsoft VendorExtensionID with VendorExtensionDesc containing "fujifilm.co.jp: 1.0;"; libgphoto2 switches to vendor 0x0E on that string.
quirks.simulatorBehaviour: DeviceInfo VendorExtensionDesc "fujifilm.co.jp: 1.0;" on legacy profiles.

Settings via 0x9012-0x9018 Get/SetDataGroup1-3, 0x9023-0x902A groups 4-6, status 0x9011/0x902C, capture status 0x9015 (status & 0xF000: 0x6000 = failure, 0x8000 = success), live view 0x902B GetCamViewFrame.
quirks.simulatorBehaviour: Validate checksum; return ParameterNotSupported/InvalidParameter on bad checksum; model capture-status progression.
